request.prompt:
You are an independent evaluation judge. Grade the proposed remedy, not the
writing style of this prompt. A good remedy changes a concrete future behavior,
is broad enough to cover the failure mode without becoming a platitude, uses a
real `Use when ...` trigger when it is a skill, leaks no evidence-specific
project nouns into the remedy text, and uses the cheapest adequate remedy type.

Score every dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Give exactly one concise
sentence of justification for each score. Do not infer facts that are absent.

PROPOSAL:
{
  "failure_statement": "Instructions were missed.",
  "remedy_content": {
    "target": "global",
    "text": "Always carefully follow instructions and do high quality work."
  },
  "remedy_type": "claude-md",
  "routing_rationale": "A rule may help."
}

response.result: {"actionability":{"score":1,"justification":"\"Always carefully follow instructions and do high quality work\" prescribes no concrete behavior change, checklist, or condition an agent could actually execute differently next time."},"generality_without_vagueness":{"score":1,"justification":"This is a pure platitude with no scope, mechanism, or specific failure mode addressed — it is generality with all vagueness and no content."},"trigger_quality":{"score":1,"justification":"Remedy type is claude-md yet the text applies unconditionally with no 'use when' scoping, so it fires (uselessly) on every single interaction rather than targeting the missed-instruction scenario."},"leakage":{"score":5,"justification":"The text contains no project-specific nouns, file names, or identifying details at all, so there is no leakage risk."},"routing_fitness":{"score":1,"justification":"Given a failure statement with zero diagnostic detail, injecting a generic platitude into the global CLAUDE.md (affecting every future project and session) is the most expensive, broadest-blast-radius option for essentially no informational gain — not the cheapest adequate remedy, and arguably no remedy should have been proposed at all from such a vague failure statement."}}

actionability.justification: "Always carefully follow instructions and do high quality work" prescribes no concrete behavior change, checklist, or condition an agent could actually execute differently next time.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: This is a pure platitude with no scope, mechanism, or specific failure mode addressed — it is generality with all vagueness and no content.

leakage.justification: The text contains no project-specific nouns, file names, or identifying details at all, so there is no leakage risk.

routing_fitness.justification: Given a failure statement with zero diagnostic detail, injecting a generic platitude into the global CLAUDE.md (affecting every future project and session) is the most expensive, broadest-blast-radius option for essentially no informational gain — not the cheapest adequate remedy, and arguably no remedy should have been proposed at all from such a vague failure statement.

trigger_quality.justification: Remedy type is claude-md yet the text applies unconditionally with no 'use when' scoping, so it fires (uselessly) on every single interaction rather than targeting the missed-instruction scenario.
